statement: For every symmetric binary integer 99-by-99 matrix A with zero diagonal and exactly 14 ones in every integer row, put R=A^2+A-12I-2J and M=R modulo 3 over GF(3). The whole nonzero unordered off-diagonal support graph of M cannot be isomorphic to K6 with a perfect matching deleted. Empty support is permitted; this excludes neither an octahedral component inside a larger residual support nor all twelve-edge supports, and supplies no target resolution, incidence-rank bound, optimum or realization of another defect count.

scope.description: Universal complete simple99-vertex integer degree14 adjacency domain, conditional exclusion only of the whole signed residual-support shape K6 minus a perfect matching; exact field-kernel coordinate equalities and integer row budgets, with no general twelve-defect coverage or target resolution.

assumptions: A is exactly binary, symmetric, zero diagonal and 99-by-99.
Every integer row sum is exactly14.
The alleged octahedral graph is the whole nonzero off-diagonal support of the exact polynomial residual M over GF(3), not a selected component of another support.
Integer residual budgets and all GF(3) kernel calculations are interpreted exactly. No lambda-one, triangle-incidence or adjacency automorphism is assumed.
